# Copilot Coding Agent — Instructions for M00C1FER profile repo

## Project context

This repo's README is the public profile page at https://github.com/M00C1FER. It's the first surface most reviewers see (Mercor LLM scan, DataAnnotation human review, Turing skills test). 90-second-scan target.

## Hard rules

- README only. No code, no scripts, no workflows.
- Length ≤ 80 lines rendered, ≤ 4 KB raw.
- Plain Markdown — no SVG animations, no typing effects, no contribution snakes, no trophy widgets.
- No "Open to work" badge.
- No motivational quotes.
- No long technology bullet lists.
- Veteran background: one sentence in body, never a header section.
- Certs: one compact line, never a bullet farm.
- No public-link to internal strategic documents.

## Acceptance signal

A PR is ready to merge when the README:
1. Loads without horizontal scroll on a 1280-wide viewport.
2. Surfaces the 2 genuinely-novel repos (`mcp-citation-research`, `memory-tool-conformance`) within the first ~15 lines.
3. Counters the "May 2-4 2026 burst" pattern with one direct sentence — not by hiding it.
4. Renders all hyperlinks correctly.
